title: Engagement Retrospective & Renewal Roadmap (Standard + Enterprise Templates)
content:
Purpose and audience:
This pack is a practical slide-by-slide template set and facilitator guide for conducting a customer engagement retrospective that doubles as a renewal readiness check. It includes a concise standard version for smaller customers and an expanded enterprise variant with deeper operational and commercial artifacts. Use this when preparing the Quarterly Business Review (QBR) or a mid-cycle renewal sync.

How to use this pack:
- Pick the variant (Standard or Enterprise) based on customer tier and renewal complexity.
- Populate the core metrics and the Renewal Readiness section at least 72 hours before the meeting.
- Share the one-page Executive Summary with the customer 48 hours prior to align expectations.
- Facilitation tips are embedded after the slides to help the AE/CSM run a focused 45–75 minute meeting depending on variant.

Slide-by-slide template (Standard variant — recommended length 30–45 minutes):
1) Title + Meeting Details
   - Slide content: Customer name, date, version of the product, meeting owner (CSM + AE), objective line (e.g., 30-min alignment on value & renewal checklist).
   - Facilitator note: keep to one line for objective.

2) One-line Executive Summary (what we achieved + ask)
   - Content: 3 bullets (Top outcome delivered, Primary risk, Proposed next-step / renewal ask).
   - Time: 2–3 minutes.

3) Health Snapshot (single-slide scorecard)
   - Key metrics: Active seats/usage %, latency/SLA incidents in period, API calls/day or prompts/min, error rate, adoption rate of core features, NPS trend.
   - Visual: 3 colored pills (Green/Amber/Red) with short rationale.

4) Value Realized: topline outcomes mapped to KPIs
   - Content: 3 customer-impact stories (quantified where possible — e.g., decreased avg. response time from 450ms to 160ms; saved $X/month).

5) Usage Trends + Adoption Risks
   - Content: charts (weekly active users, query distribution by endpoint, heavy vs light customers), short interpretations.

6) Support & Technical Health
   - Content: open tickets by priority, outstanding blockers, configuration drift, integration health score.

7) Commercial Pulse: ARR motion & renewal posture
   - Content: current ARR, upsell opportunities, renewal window, renew probability (score), pricing notes.

8) Recommendations & Proposed Plan
   - Content: prioritized actions (3 items), owners, and required internal support (SRE or Solutions Engineer).

9) Renewal Readiness Checklist (one-line status for each item)
   - Items: Contract end date, legal review status, procurement lead identified, success metrics agreed, executive sponsor engaged.

10) Next Steps & Owners (calendar commitments)
   - Content: 30/60/90 day plan, assigned owners, date for renewal decision.

Slide-by-slide template (Enterprise variant — recommended length 60–90 minutes):
- Include all Standard slides, plus:
11) Executive Alignment narrative (1 page slide with executive ask and sponsor mapping).
12) Architecture & Data Flow Deep-dive (appendix-ready): callouts on data residency, KMS/HSM usage, VPC/private deployment notes.
13) Performance & Cost Profile (token-level economics): suggested batching/cache recommendations and projected cost delta for proposed configuration changes.
14) Rollout & Canary Plan for any upcoming model/infra changes (risk mitigation & rollback plan).
15) Renewals & Commercial Options: multi-year discounts, reserved capacity scenarios, dedicated vs hosted comparison table.
16) Appendix: Audit logs, compliance evidence snippets, incident timeline (if relevant).

Renewal tracker (example — paste into slide/table):
- Contract end: 2025-12-31
- Renewal owner (CS): Aisha Patel
- Procurement contact: Jane Doe (Acme Corp)
- Renewal probability: 78% (score rationale: usage up 18%, but exec sponsor not engaged)
- Outstanding blockers: SSO integration non-complete; PO approval pending
- Next internal action: Solutions Eng kickoff (owner: Marcus Liu) by 2025-02-10

Facilitator notes & tips:
- Start by confirming objectives (1 min). Keep the Exec Summary slide as the meeting north star.
- Use the Health Snapshot to drive the narrative: don’t let deep technical questions derail the primary commercial conversation — park them to the appendix.
- For enterprise customers, bring a Solutions Engineer to commit to technical owners on the call.
- Use the Renewal Readiness checklist to close action items with owners and dates on the call.

Risk signals and recommended mitigations (pack-ready):
- Falling daily active usage: run a 2-week adoption sprint with in-product prompts + playbooks.
- Increasing error/latency: enable temporary fallback model variant + schedule infra incident post-mortem.
- Procurement delay: offer interim one-time extension and prioritize billing paperwork with finance CS Ops.

Customizable snippets to copy into slides:
- "Topline outcome: Delivered 42% reduction in average token cost for the search pipeline by enabling prefix caching and model variant routing."
- "Primary risk: Executive sponsor has not acknowledged ROI metrics; recommendation to schedule a 15-minute exec readout before formal renewal."
- "Ask: Authorize a 12-month reserved capacity commit with 10% discount and a 2-week pilot on Dedicated nodes for high-throughput routes."

Appendix content suggestions (short bulleted lists you can paste into appendix slides):
- Data exports to include: 90-day token usage by route, top 10 customers by latency, error-by-endpoint table.
- Technical tickets to surface: top 3 P1/P2 incidents last 6 months with resolution summary.
- Success stories: 2 brief case studies with measured ROI.

Checklist for pre-meeting prep (CSM):
- Pull token-level cost report and last 90-day usage (owner: CS ops).
- Confirm exec sponsor availability and send 1-page exec summary.
- Update renewal tracker and pre-populate suggested commercial options.
- Prep Solutions Eng and SRE talking points for appendix deep-dive.

Versioning and reuse guidance:
- Keep the one-line Executive Summary immutable across versions (used as shared artifact).
- Number deck versions (v0.1 initial draft, v0.2 post-internal review, v1.0 shared).
- Store final slide deck and tracker row in the customer folder and link to CRM opportunity (example linked artifacts above).

Open questions / To finalize for this pack:
- Do we want a dedicated slide for model governance for regulated customers? (recommended for enterprise in healthcare/finance).
- Standardize the renewal probability rubric (suggested scale: 0–100 with drivers: usage trend, exec engagement, contract stage, support backlog).

Quick checklist for follow-up after the meeting:
- Convert agreed actions into CRM tasks within 48 hours.
- Send slide PDF + one-page Executive Summary to customer and internal stakeholders.
- Update renewal tracker and escalate any 'red' items to renewal pod lead.

Contact & ownership: Aisha Patel (CS lead) — use this template for any mid-market or enterprise renewal prep. For template feedback or to propose edits, tag the doc in the CS channel and create a small PR in the renewal-templates repo.

End of pack.
